title: Nexus-B2A Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool Suite
description: Standardized MCP tool definitions exposed over SSE and Streamable HTTP for AI purchasing agents.

tools.name: query_industrial_catalog
tools.description: Search verified industrial distributor stock for mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic spares. Returns verified SKUs, stock levels, OEM certifications, and unit pricing in INR.

query_text.description: Part number or technical specifications (e.g. '6205-2RSH' or '1.5kW 1440 RPM')

max_dispatch_days.description: Maximum promised dispatch time in days

tools.name: create_acp_checkout_session
tools.description: Locks in stock and pricing with an authorized distributor and generates an AP2 Cart Mandate. Requires an active AP2 Intent Mandate token.

intent_mandate_token.description: Cryptographically signed AP2 Intent Mandate token

tools.name: execute_mandate_payment
tools.description: Executes programmatic payment against the checkout session using UPI Reserve Pay (Purpose 77) or delegated tokenized card.

payment_credential_token.description: Scoped single-use payment token or UPI block reference
